```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

# Load data

```{r}
cytokines <- read.csv("../data/derived/cytokines_avg-results.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)

samplabs <- read.csv("../data/derived/timepoint_key.csv")
```


# Format

```{r}
samplab.form <- samplabs %>%
  select(Subject.Number, placebo)

pre.cyto.form <- cytokines %>%
  separate(Sample, into = c("Subject.Number", "timepoint"), sep = "-") %>%
  mutate(Subject.Number = as.numeric(gsub("^0", "", Subject.Number)),
         timepoint = gsub("\\.1", "", timepoint)) %>%
  left_join(samplab.form) %>%
  mutate(study.tpoint = case_when(placebo == "Week 0" & timepoint == "1" ~ "pre.P",
                                  placebo == "Week 0" & timepoint == "2" ~ "post.P",
                                  placebo == "Week 0" & timepoint == "3" ~ "pre.BRB",
                                  placebo == "Week 0" & timepoint == "4" ~ "post.BRB",
                                  placebo == "Week 6" & timepoint == "3" ~ "pre.P",
                                  placebo == "Week 6" & timepoint == "4" ~ "post.P",
                                  placebo == "Week 6" & timepoint == "1" ~ "pre.BRB",
                                  placebo == "Week 6" & timepoint == "2" ~ "post.BRB"))

cyto.form <- 
  pre.cyto.form %>%
  filter(grepl("BRB", study.tpoint)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, study.tpoint, cytokine, avg.res) %>%
  spread(key = study.tpoint, value = avg.res)
```

```{r}
check.norm.dists <- cyto.form %>%
  mutate(dif.brb = post.BRB - pre.BRB) %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(norm.test = shapiro.test(dif.brb)$p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cytokine, norm.test) %>%
  distinct()

norm.pass <- filter(check.norm.dists, norm.test > 0.05)$cytokine
norm.fail <- filter(check.norm.dists, norm.test < 0.05)$cytokine
```

# Run T tests

```{r}
run_cyto_ttest <- function(x){
  tmp <- cyto.form %>%
    filter(cytokine == x)
  
  t.test(tmp$pre.BRB, tmp$post.BRB, paired = T)
}
```

```{r}
norm.ttests <- lapply(norm.pass, function(x) run_cyto_ttest(x))
names(norm.ttests) <- norm.pass
```

```{r}
norm.ttests
```

# Run Wilcoxon tests

```{r}
run_cyto_wilcox <- function(x){
  tmp <- cyto.form %>%
    filter(cytokine == x)
  
  wilcox.test(tmp$pre.BRB, tmp$post.BRB, paired = T)
}
```

```{r}
nonnorm.tests <- lapply(norm.fail, function(x) run_cyto_wilcox(x))
names(nonnorm.tests) <- norm.fail
```

```{r}
nonnorm.tests
```

```{r}
cyto.form %>%
  gather(-Subject.Number, -cytokine, key = "study.visit",
         value = "cytokine.amount") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = study.visit, y = cytokine.amount)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = study.visit), 
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~cytokine, scales = "free")
ggsave("../figures/exploratory-cytokines_boxplots_facet.png",
       width = 6.5, height = 9)
```

```{r}
run_cyto_ttest <- function(x){
  tmp <- cyto.form %>%
    filter(cytokine == x)
  
  t.test(tmp[[grep("pre"), names(tmp)]], 
         tmp[[grep("post", names(tmp))]], 
         paired = T)
}

run_cyto_wilcox <- function(x){
  tmp <- cyto.form %>%
    filter(cytokine == x)
  
  wilcox.test(tmp[[grep("pre"), names(tmp)]], 
              tmp[[grep("post", names(tmp))]], 
              paired = T)
}

cytokineDifferenceSigTests <- function(interventionInitial) {
  cyto.form <- 
  pre.cyto.form %>%
  filter(grepl(interventionInitial, study.tpoint)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, study.tpoint, cytokine, avg.res) %>%
  spread(key = study.tpoint, value = avg.res) %>%
  
  check.norm.dists <- 
    cyto.form %>%
  mutate(dif.brb = post - pre) %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(norm.test = shapiro.test(dif.brb)$p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cytokine, norm.test) %>%
  distinct()

norm.pass <- filter(check.norm.dists, norm.test > 0.05)$cytokine
norm.fail <- filter(check.norm.dists, norm.test < 0.05)$cytokine

norm.ttests <- lapply(norm.pass, function(x) run_cyto_ttest(x))
names(norm.ttests) <- norm.pass

nonnorm.tests <- lapply(norm.fail, function(x) run_cyto_wilcox(x))
names(nonnorm.tests) <- norm.fail

output[[1]] <- norm.ttests
output[[2]] <- nonnorm.tests
}

cytokineDifferenceSigTests("B")
```


# Check this all on placebo

```{r}


cyto.form <- 
  pre.cyto.form %>%
  filter(grepl("P", study.tpoint)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, study.tpoint, cytokine, avg.res) %>%
  spread(key = study.tpoint, value = avg.res)


check.norm.dists <- cyto.form %>%
  mutate(dif.brb = post.P - pre.P) %>%
  group_by(cytokine) %>%
  mutate(norm.test = shapiro.test(dif.brb)$p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cytokine, norm.test) %>%
  distinct()

norm.pass <- filter(check.norm.dists, norm.test > 0.05)$cytokine
norm.fail <- filter(check.norm.dists, norm.test < 0.05)$cytokine
```

# Run T tests

```{r}
run_cyto_ttest <- function(x){
  tmp <- cyto.form %>%
    filter(cytokine == x)
  
  t.test(tmp$pre.P, tmp$post.P, paired = T)
}
```

```{r}
norm.ttests <- lapply(norm.pass, function(x) run_cyto_ttest(x))
names(norm.ttests) <- norm.pass
```

```{r}
norm.ttests
```
